**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **Scope checked:** full-document searches for "solicit", "induce", "employ", "hire", "recruit", plus a review of the Section 12 (Customer Responsibilities) outline and § 12.3 in full.
- **Result:** there is no non-solicitation, no-poach, or no-hire covenant binding Meridian Fieldworks anywhere in the Agreement. § 12.3 affirmatively protects us: it preserves our right to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment.
- **Position met:** this is our preferred outcome (no non-solicit on Customer), so the fallback (narrow mutual 12-month non-solicit with general-advertising carve-out) is unnecessary and we should not introduce one.
- **Watch item outside this rule:** § 12.4 imposes a 24-month post-term non-compete on Customer, which is a restrictive covenant we would ordinarily strike — flagging for the non-compete rule rather than editing it here.
